summary.result: At a cost of over $30/tCO₂, proceeding with LFG, wind, biomass, small hydro, fuel switching, and PV would be cost-effective.
summary.background: The purpose of this paper is to compare the GHG emission abatement cost of CDM projects among four countries using the abatement cost information each country.
summary.method: Economies of time existed for small hydro, LFG, methane avoidance, and energy efficiency, and there was an effect of technology development on wind, methane avoidance, and biomass.
